title: Migration
subtitle: Rename many repositories by rules, or move them to another owner — planned here, checked and run through the queue.
adminOnly: Only repositories you administer are listed.

rules.title: Rules
rules.order: Applied in this order: remove prefix/suffix → find & replace → case → add prefix/suffix. Characters GitHub doesn't allow become “-”. Edit any new name by hand below.

transfer.badOwner: Not a valid user / organization name
transfer.newNameHint: optional — keep the name if empty

notes.title: Good to know
notes.renameRedirects: GitHub redirects the old name — web links, git remotes and the API keep working until the old name is reused.
notes.renamePages: A GitHub Pages site moves to the new URL (that one isn't redirected).
notes.renameClones: Home folders follow a renamed repository automatically; other clones can keep working through the redirect or be pointed at the new URL.
notes.transferMoves: Issues, pull requests, wiki, stars and watchers move with the repository; links and git remotes redirect.
notes.transferUser: Moving to a person: they get an email and must accept (within a day) — until then nothing changes.
notes.transferOrg: Moving to an organization: you need permission to create repositories there; it happens right away.
notes.transferAccess: Afterwards you may no longer administer it — the dry run checks owner and names first, and you confirm by typing.
